label: Existential fact: ExistentialFact A d says the fact d is true at a world exactly when some…
definition: ExistentialFact A d says the fact d is true at a world exactly when some candidate individual exists there. For a two-member roster it is the disjunction E a or E b. Necessity of d (NecessaryFact) is de dicto necessary population, not the necessity of any one individual. Concreteness is not modelled.
note: Analyst-stated condition for #485; it is under test, not asserted. A sourced reading would need pinned witnesses for the grounding-of-disjunction literature listed on #485 (Merlo 2020, Trogdon 2013, Leuenberger 2014), none of which was read for this work.
